text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day just before summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright, today's photo is good to go.
Post-workout pics are popular with both demographics,
so I just can't help using them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: With the festival coming up, I've gotta step up my social media posts a bit...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (...What is it? The atmosphere somehow feels—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I can see my current areas for improvement.
Now I just need to decide on the adjustments today...
and get into the right rhythm and cycle for the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Supreme Auspice!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(It's still rough around the edges, but it's clearly different from before!
When did she—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
......I see.
So this time, Rickey, it's your turn to chase after them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if Acute-san
felt this way too...—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose, Rickey. Because I also
have a place where I need to stand!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Senior Year summer training camp is finally here.
To prepare for the JBC Classic and the battles beyond,
I need to take my strength to the next level here...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Rickey's growth lately has been incredible.
Thanks to that, I'm all fired up thinking,
'I can't afford to lose!'...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Bring on hell or whatever else you've got!
I'll be counting on you again this year!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The scorching training camp was about to begin—!
